spec2def(wing32.dll wing32.spec)

# wing32.dll is all Rust (wing32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wing32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# wing32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wing32-rust/src/wing32/wing32.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(wing32_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(wing32_shims PRIVATE libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
target_compile_definitions(wing32_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(wing32 wing32-cargo wing32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE wing32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wing32_shims)
